text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While moving down the hallway, I spotted
Kawakami Princess overcome with grief.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! My face, as a princess! How could this...!
This is simply unacceptable~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please listen to this!
Yesterday, for my beauty routine, I did a cucumber pack, and—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I tried a mud pack, a tea pack, and a honey pack all at once...and now my skin is a total disaster!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess ought to have an iron face, too...
How utterly pathetic of me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess was feeling down
over her skin breakout.
